title: Parts of the Hand and Hand Expressions

vocabulary.meaning_en: the part at the end of your arm with fingers and a thumb
vocabulary.example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the short, thick finger at the side of your hand
vocabulary.note_ar: حرف b صامت: /θʌm/. لا يُعدّ thumb من fingers
vocabulary.note_en: Silent b: /θʌm/. A thumb is not called a finger.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the finger next to the thumb, used for pointing
the longest finger, in the middle of the hand
vocabulary.example: The middle finger is the longest.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the finger between the middle finger and the little finger, where people wear rings
vocabulary.example: She wears a silver ring on her ring finger.
I hurt my pinky in the door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the inside part of your hand
vocabulary.example: She held the coin in her palm.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the outside part of the hand, opposite the palm
vocabulary.example: I know this city like the back of my hand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the joint that connects your hand to your arm
vocabulary.example: I wear my watch on my left wrist.

vocabulary.meaning_en: your heartbeat, which you can feel on your wrist
the four long parts of the hand (not the thumb)
vocabulary.example: I have five fingers? No: four fingers and a thumb!

vocabulary.meaning_en: the hard part at the end of each finger

vocabulary.example: wash your hands of sth = wash your hands of something

fine_lines.title: finger vs thumb
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية لليد أربعة fingers وإبهام واحد thumb، والإبهام لا يُعدّ إصبعًا عادةً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In English, a hand has four fingers and one thumb; the thumb is usually not called a finger.

examples.sentence: She has a ring on one finger.
He hurt his thumb with a hammer.

fine_lines.title: palm vs back of the hand
fine_lines.explanation_ar: palm داخل اليد، وback of the hand ظاهرها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: The palm is the inside; the back of the hand is the outside.

examples.sentence: Put the medicine in your palm.
There is a small cut on the back of my hand.

expressions.example: The business is hanging on by its fingernails.
My exam is tomorrow. Fingers crossed!

expressions.meaning_en: stop being involved or responsible for something
expressions.example: I've washed my hands of this project; it's not my problem now.

expressions.phrase: have your finger on the pulse
expressions.example: Our manager has her finger on the pulse of the market.
Your future is all in your hands.

expressions.phrase: know something like the back of your hand
expressions.example: I know my hometown like the back of my hand.

questions.question: What is another name for the index finger?
questions.explanation_ar: index finger = pointer لأننا نشير به.

questions.question: What do you call the inside of the hand?
What can you feel on your wrist?
questions.explanation_en: You can feel your pulse there.

questions.question: What part of your hand do you use to scratch yourself?
"I wash my hands of this problem" means:
choices: I don't want to be responsible for it any more.
questions.explanation_ar: wash your hands of = يرفع يده عن الأمر.

questions.question: "She has her finger on the pulse" means she ___.
"The company is hanging on by its fingernails" means it is ___.
Which word has a silent letter: /rɪst/?
questions.explanation_en: The w in wrist is silent.
